decisionRule: Closing pick v2 (profile v34), registered fidelity replication CPC-R of confirmation CPC part A. Written before any
Why: CPC part A ran on a tree whose replay adapter ignored the task's real game id (src/simulation/ai_iteration/
ranked_adapter.ts used `sim-${terrainSeed}`), so the game-id-seeded stones did not match the real games on the two Block
boards, 3fd7b865 and 909e7898; CPC's registration had stated real game ids. Both arms shared each board, so CPC's paired
estimate is internally valid, but its population was not exactly the registered one. CPC's result and adoption stand as
recorded; CPC-R measures part A again on the registered population.
Design: CPC part A's 6 human games, armies, arms (control: the battery's production level 4; candidate: closing pick v2's
level 4), replay seat (life-run15) and v33/v34 fight driver (server 565bc0e, common 9b80f76e), on a copy of the CPC tree
whose ranked_adapter.ts takes the task's game id (the owner-replay override; checked before registration: the replayed
stones equal common's scatteredMountainsForSeed(real game id) on both Block boards). 64 fresh seeds per game (namespace
closing-pick-confirmation-cpc-r-20261124-v1), both arms on the same seeds. Estimate: the mean of the 6 games'
differences, each game weighted equally; 95% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of seeds within each game (paired;
Gate R1: the estimate is above 0 and its 95% lower bound is above 0.
If R1 passes, profile v34 stands and the CPC record gains this replication and the terrain erratum. If R1 fails, the
owner is told that closing pick v2 did not replicate on faithful terrain, with the recommendation to switch it off
(HOC_A19_CLOSING_PICK=off) until a new confirmation passes; the owner decides. Either way the result is recorded as is.
